svg.desc: MATLAB, The MathWorks, Inc. Version 26.1.0.3346908 R2026a Update 5

g.text: Every statistic is recomputed from the unique undirected positive-Pearson edge set
Matrix diagonal counts within-region edges once; off-diagonal cells mirror the same cross-region total.
Hubs sum all incident weights; bridges sum only cross-region weights. These are descriptive ranks.
